inputs.tags: symphonic metal, female operatic soprano lead vocals, powerful clear angelic voice, double bass drums, fast driving drum rhythm, distorted rhythm guitars, lead guitar solo, full orchestra with strings and brass, epic choir, harpsichord and music box accents, gothic baroque atmosphere, cinematic, dramatic and bombastic
inputs.lyrics:
[intro]
[instrumental]

[verse]
Midnight bells are calling through the velvet and the flame
Every candle in the hall is whispering my name
Broken mirrors hold the faces of the ones who came before
I will sing until the darkness opens up its door

[pre-chorus]
Rise, rise, let the thunder take the sky
Hear the orchestra of ghosts begin to cry

[chorus]
Sing, Seraphine, sing into the night
Break the silver mirrors and set us free with light
Angel voice of midnight, let the hall ignite
Sing, Seraphine, sing, tonight

[instrumental]

[verse]
Countess of the shadows in a gown of black and gold
Keeps the music locked in glass where all the dreams grow cold
But a melody can wake what time forgot to bury
Every note a burning rose and every breath a mercy

[pre-chorus]
Rise, rise, let the thunder take the sky
Hear the orchestra of ghosts begin to cry

[chorus]
Sing, Seraphine, sing into the night
Break the silver mirrors and set us free with light
Angel voice of midnight, let the hall ignite
Sing, Seraphine, sing, tonight

[bridge]
Softly now, the music box remembers
One last waltz among the dying embers

[instrumental]

[chorus]
Sing, Seraphine, sing into the night
Twelve bells are tolling, and the glass is breaking bright
Angel voice of midnight, rising into light
Sing, Seraphine, sing, tonight

[outro]
Aaah, aaah
The morning comes, the music box is playing
[instrumental]
